items.html: However, the light of the lower seven that took only from the Guf downward is from the Sium of Shibbolet HaZakan and below. This is also why they do not have vapors to shine for them, but they are implied in the words, “And the arms of his hands were made golden,” which is the ten drops thrown from between the nails, as mentioned in Tikkun 69, since for themselves are the phase of kings, for the revoking of the kings was because he was still not established as one Adam, male and female.
